scope: Validation-only; test data read for integrity audits, never new test inference or model selection

audit.normalization: All 12 checkpoints bit-exact equal train-only feature mean/std; validation/test excluded
limitations: Original recording UUID is grouping authority; unknown duplicate exports or adjacent independently named recordings cannot be ruled out without acquisition logs/content deduplication.
Known pilot/smoke sources excluded from test; smoke-exposed validation is not a pristine independent sample.
Original test has already been inspected in preceding round; frozen for provenance and never used for this selection.

content_audit.interpretation: Recorded acquisition timestamps and exact source content hashes; does not detect re-encoded duplicates or unknown clock errors.

bootstrap.warning: Exploratory paired cluster bootstrap on only 10 reused validation recordings; not independent confirmatory evidence, no correction for candidate search. Absent classes count zero in fixed four-class episode Macro-F1. h15 changes both horizon and architecture.

gradient_probe.interpretation: Gradient alignment at selected shared-trunk checkpoints only; negative values show local competing objectives, cannot establish cause of validation gap or compare training trajectories. No optimizer step or checkpoint mutation.

benchmark.scope: Single request, batch1 containing 3 camera clips; real validation RGB and states; synchronized CUDA; includes H2D/preprocessing/fusion and logits D2H. Paced includes Agent schema/probability checks. Decode/storage/transport/ROS excluded from inference; offline full-video decode separately measured.

head_benchmark.scope: Same cached real validation features, batch1, synchronized GPU, H2D normalization and D2H logits included; excludes common encoder.
